reviews.title: So Cute - One Wish / Suggestion
reviews.text: This app is so great.  No ads (um excuse me? No ads for a free app? That’s so rare and so so refreshing!!!) the art is adorable.  My only wish is that you could chose from competition mode to team mode.  As a chronically ill girly, I would love to be a little less stressed with my physical limits and be able to do this in team mode with one or more friends.  Other than that it’s amazing.

reviews.title: So much fun!
reviews.text: I’m almost to Buckleberry Ferry!! This app is so cute and fun! I love checking my progress, and seeing how I match up to the other people in my groups. Even though we are far apart, we can all participate in the journey to Mt Doom. Highly recommend for a fun step counter.

reviews.title: Amazing app
reviews.text: The first thing I noticed was how I wasn’t bombarded with notices for a monthly subscription. I appreciate that and I appreciate the love that went into this app, it’s simple and fun. Sometimes throughout the day I just like to check on it and see how far I’ve gotten, love the feeling of accomplishment I get from seeing a new backdrop when I make it to a new milestone. Amazing job guys👍

reviews.title: Add adjustable map
reviews.text: Started with some college friends. Simple but fun. It’s frustrating that I can’t zoom in on the map, especially when our group is all so close together.

reviews.title: Genius.
reviews.text:
I LOVE that this app exists. I’ve always wanted to track my walks in alignment with the journey to Mount Doom, and now I can!
I have one nitpick and one recommendation.
The nitpick is I just started on the Bree section, but it still says I’m in the Barrow Downs? I found that odd, but it’s a minor gripe. I adore that it shows where you are in the journey and I was pleasantly surprised when I saw I was in the Old Forest :)
The recommendation is it would be cool if you could see where you are when the Fellowship breaks apart rather than just following Frodo because the path splits for various people. Maybe show Aragorn’s, Gandalf’s, Merry’s, Pippin’s journeys, too?

Otherwise, very minor things. I love this app and I check it every day :D

reviews.title: Simple and perfect
reviews.text: I love this app so far, it’s so nice because it’s so simple. It doesn’t do anything fancy, and that’s all I wanted, just something to make me feel happy and like I’m progressing to something. I love that you can create groups and challenges with friends. Great job on this app!

reviews.title: Clean, simple, beautiful
reviews.text: Clean layout - no clutter, ads, or frills. Simple and straightforward- counts your steps and gives you goals, no complications or pestering offers. Beautiful - background artwork changes with your changing landscape and keeps you engaged. It’s fun to do it with friends and see each other’s progress. My only suggestions would be to make each milestone more of a celebration (since it takes such an effort to get there!) and to add an epilogue or Part 2 for after you reach Mordor - Ithilien, Minas Tirith/Aragorn’s coronation, Eowyn’s betrothal feast, etc, back to the Shire.
